summary.title: Omnipod 5 support added to dev branch
changes: Omnipod 5 support is now included in Trio's dev branch.
For the first Omnipod 5 pod, deactivate your current pod then choose Switch Pod Type and select Omnipod 5.
Trio automatically retrieves the required certificate and shows progress screens during setup.
After tapping Continue you reach the Pair Pod screen and can safely fill and pair the Omnipod 5.
